item.title: HÉR Premiere Debut Album “Monochrome”, Out Now
item.description: HÉR are seekers and storytellers. item.description: Morten Veland photo by Tom Knudsen Morten Veland (SIRENIA, MORTEMIA and founder of TRISTANIA) released the fifth Mortemia song from ‘The Cover Collab Sessions’ today.
